title: Size HAR request bodies from raw content
answers: HAR export crashes for malformed flows
Which content property should HAR request bodySize use?
body:
Symptom: HAR export crashes when a flow contains malformed content encoding.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/savehar.py:SaveHar computed request bodySize using request.content, whose decoding can raise ValueError.
Fix pattern: Compute byte-size metadata from request.raw_content, returning 0 for absent or empty bytes, without decoding the body.
Constraints: Applies to HAR request bodySize, not decoded payload text. test/mitmproxy/addons/test_savehar.py:test_content_raises verifies HAR export succeeds even when both request.content and response.content raise ValueError.
applies: HAR request body-size calculation and export robustness for malformed content encoding.
